name: CM Payments for WooCommerce
author: cm.com

sections.description:
CM Payments for WooCommerce adds a CM payment gateway for WooCommerce checkouts, supporting both Classic and Block-based checkout experiences. This plugin allows you to easily integrate CM Payments into your WooCommerce store, providing a seamless payment experience for your customers.

Features

  • Easy integration with WooCommerce for both Classic and Block checkouts.
  • Secure payment processing through CM Payments.
  • Customizable payment settings.
  • Supports multiple languages.
  • Supports both test and production modes

Support

If you encounter any issues or have questions, please visit the support forum or contact us at marketplace.dev@cm.com.

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPL v2 or later. See the LICENSE file for more details.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress dashboard
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “CM Payments for WooCommerce”
  4. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file
  2. Log in to your WordPress dashboard
  3. Navigate to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  4. Upload the ZIP file and click “Install Now”
  5. Activate the plugin

Configuration

  1. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Payments
  2. Find “CM Payments” in the list and click “Set up”
  3. Enter your API credentials
  4. Configure with either test or production API credentials
  5. Save changes
sections.faq:
Is this plugin free?

Yes, CM Payments for WooCommerce is completely free to use.

Do I need to have WooCommerce installed?

Yes, this plugin requires WooCommerce to be installed and activated.

How do I test the payment gateway?

You can enable test mode in the plugin settings to test transactions without processing real payments.
